GEMINI_API_KEY.description: REQUIRED. Google Gemini API key for AI clip analysis, titles/thumbnails and voice-over. Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Can also be passed per request via the X-Gemini-Key header.

MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS.description: Maximum number of video jobs processed in parallel. Each job is CPU/RAM intensive; lower keeps small Railway plans stable.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Optional. AWS access key for S3 upload of generated clips.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Optional. AWS secret key paired with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.

AWS_REGION.description: Optional. AWS region for the S3 bucket used for clip uploads.

AWS_S3_BUCKET.description: Optional. S3 bucket name where generated clips are uploaded.

AWS_S3_PUBLIC_BUCKET.description: Optional. Public S3 bucket name whose objects get public URLs in generated pages.
